notes.title: 💙 VERSION 1.0 IS COMING!!🚀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/3d7d7917a753122eeec6d55d55a051aa760eff71.png[/img]

[h1]💙RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT!!🚀[/h1]

Version 1.0 will be coming to your rooftop on [b]NOVEMBER 13th![/b]

Watch our devlog to see what's coming in our biggest update yet 👇

[previewyoutube=MCpwjJQl578;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]TEXT VERSION OF THE UPDATE: [/h2]

[h3]Story[/h3]
At last, you’ll be able to complete the story, discover what happened to Cosmopolis and our hero, and make an important choice!

[h3]New Rooftops[/h3]
Remember all those "coming soon" zones? Well now, you’ll be able to visit all the rooftops you’ve been curious about, plus we’ve added several bigger new locations!

[h3]The Carnival[/h3]
We know you’ve all been eagerly waiting to visit the carnival since we last showed it off, and it will finally be accessible with this new update!

[h3]A New Friend![/h3]
In the last update, we introduced the relationship system with characters, and of course, we’ve added a new character in version 1.0! Meet Bombshell Barbara - a woman with an “explosive” personality who needs your help! Befriend her, help her work through her problems, and she’ll make sure nobody messes with you!

[h3]New Smart Tower Levels[/h3]
We’ve added levels 3 and 4 of the Smart Tower, meaning you can now travel to every corner of Cosmopolis and visit all the previously locked locations! You’ll also be able to unlock new upgrade modules, including the weather control module, solar generator, and battery upgrades. And don’t forget the enhancements for minions, batteries, and tools. Get ready to explore!

[h3]Resource Progression[/h3]
As technology advances, so do production methods. We’ve added a third level for the press, along with a nano-forge - a new structure where you can create entirely new materials like techno-wood, tungsten, carbon, and reactors! And, of course, you can now finally fully upgrade all your tools to the max level!

[h3]Teleports[/h3]
The rooftop was already pretty big, and now it’s even bigger. Moving around has become a real issue, but we have a solution: teleportation. Place one here, place another there, and voilà! Now no one will be able to keep up, except maybe the game camera.

[h3]Farming, Fishing, and Cooking[/h3]
New plants and crops have arrived - cream beans and noodle grass. And you thought the cheese tree was the height of Cosmopolis agriculture? You can now upgrade the fishing rod to level 3 to catch four new, delightful post-apocalyptic fish. And with all these new ingredients, we’re thrilled to announce the arrival of the fourth and final level of the kitchen, along with dozens of new recipes for you to try.

[h3]Progression[/h3]
We’ve added all the missing structure levels: Level 2 and 3 for the Cultivator and UV Tower, Level 3 for the Bio-Generator, Crypto Farm, and anti-infection spray, and of course, Level 4 for the Barricade.

[h3]Recycling[/h3]
A few words about our latest addition: recycling. We’ve expanded resource recycling in the game, with dismantling options now available on the workbench, farmer’s table, and synthesizer, including levels 2 and 3. All your “spam” resources (we promise we didn’t mean for them to be spam) are now integrated into the broader resource system. Pre-created resources can also be broken down into their components.

notes.content:
[h1]Hello, future-dwellers! [/h1]

Here's the update you’ve all been waiting for! At the Housewarming party, it didn't seem to go just as planned, so it's time to win back some trust and build more of a relationship with your fellow rooftop friends!

[h2]Explore a new rooftop[/h2]
We have a new roof - the Entertainment Zone! Hotel guests would swim, exercise, sing, dance, and watch movies. We've even added new themed items to dismantle. Keep exploring to find a new cosmetic item 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/cf1ab13e054cd02f11b6a4fe8ce8df49131604df.png[/img]

[h2]Continuation of the Main Storyline[/h2]
The long-awaited continuation of the main storyline is here but where could we go after the housewarming party? 
Now we have the answer for you. Although the story is not yet finished we do have some surprises waiting to keep you guessing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/1dbdc0ba5709607821c979dcb01fc33d60f87d5c.png[/img]

[h2]Relationships[/h2]
Develop relationships with your friends on the rooftop! After such a housewarming, it’s only natural that you'd want to cheer them up. As you develop relationships, you can give them gifts that you find on expeditions, play mini-games, and complete daily tasks! With each relationship level, new rewards will unlock for you.

The relationship system is our main focus for this update. We hope you will find it as exciting and fun to befriend a fridge as we did implementing it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/56846af14b2fb7449ff9da462723d3e67b837e53.png[/img]

[h2]Radio Module[/h2]
Have you wondered why you communicate through the Smart Tower? We have an answer: now you can. Every day, you will discover lost messages from the residents of flooded Cosmopolis every day. Some will even talk back like the Game Master! More characters will be communicating in the future, so check back often.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/df96231424d7dd19a5b5397a2cc66c13677a0f12.png[/img]

[h2]New Smart Tower Modules[/h2]
In this update, we’ve prepared a whole series of new modules. Starting with the long-awaited tool upgrades. Spend as little time as possible dismantling trash! 

Want to know the weather forecast? Install the weather forecast module.
Do your minions often run out of power? Increase their battery life! Speaking of our little helpers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c9dd55ac06ea9265dc9fb62a8ea5dd70156a649d.png[/img]

[h2]Minions[/h2]
Speaking of our little robot minions, with every update, we give these cuties a significant dose of attention. We constantly work to improve the minion AI to make them smarter along with some new added features too:
[list]
[*] We have some new roles: The water carrier, aqua genius, and repairman. These minions will water the flower beds, refill the sprinklers, and repair your buildings.
[*] We’ve improved minion behavior and added statuses and custom routes.
[*] All minions, not just gatherers, can search for and collect resources from the ground. (It wasn't easy, but we finally did it!)  
[*] Idle minions will no longer waste energy.
[*] Last but not least, Minions will now complete tasks to the end! Sometimes, the goal is so far that the battery almost dies. Don’t worry - other minions have volunteered to help to the end and then go back to recharge.
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/a273201852669e1aac4884bb93b64eef83ef2326.png[/img]

[h2]And a Few More Small Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] We redesigned the floor patches to look more plastic. Many players suggested they should be made of planks, but we have other ideas. And, trust us, carrying hundreds of planks for all the patches would be extremely tiring.
[*] New resource - reactor.
[*] There are three levels of repair kits with new models and animations. Repair minions also use them – be sure to check them out!
[*] The water storage barrel has become an essential element of gameplay. We have moved it to the regular storage category. We will return everything to those who managed to buy it with coupons.
[/list]

notes.title: 'Solar Energy' Major Content Update! 🚀
notes.content:
[h2]What’s new?[/h2]

[previewyoutube=MFTLwlQiTJk;full][/previewyoutube]
The new rooftop is available after completing the New Home quest. Exploring this rooftop will reveal the story of Muscle Claus, "the strongest" man in Cosmopolis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/66e7156b2154d1304666ac31713f987b039fdfef.jpg[/img]

[h3]Solar generator and battery 🌞[/h3]

Two structures that expand the game's electrical system. The solar generator operates without fuel but won't work at night or in dark weather. The battery helps preserve energy in the electrical grid, allowing for long-lasting autonomy. Together, they create a powerful grid that doesn't even need fuel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/06fff21d96187e06fccaaf045a8d669898c73331.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/db0d0dda269543376a96614f2cc9cb4a287a0d86.gif[/img]

[h3]New tools 🔧[/h3]

Level 3 drill and level 3 injector. These will help disassemble everything on the rooftop.
The automatic sprinkler and pump have been upgraded to level 3, and the water supply and irrigation system have received their long-awaited improvements.

[h3]Days of the week 📅[/h3]

A week cycle has been added to the game. It diversifies the expedition system, with many points of interest now only open on certain days of the week. Conversely, the rewards at these points have been increased. Also, traders do not work on certain days of the week. But where do they go? They replenish their inventory. Track the days when traders and points of interest are available in the new character menu tab - the Calendar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c9e57d82e0ea5b0081bde4452ed2b6fe9da74b7e.gif[/img]

[h3]Weather ⛅[/h3]

Another feature introduced to diversify the world of I Am Future is the weather cycle. Currently, overcast and rainy weather has been created. Each affects the rooftop. Mushrooms even grow during overcast weather. In rainy weather, you don't need to water the plants; the barrels automatically fill with fresh water. Remember to pour the saltwater first, as they don't mix well. However, rainy weather is considered dark for the solar generator and won't charge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4aade83c6fdc5e35f7dd9ae16309cacdc5b9aecb.png[/img]

There is a new device to disassemble, but we suggest you find it yourself. Now, all devices that you disassemble may contain an unexpected find.

[h3]Wires across bridges and ladders ⚡[/h3]

Remember how often you wrote that electrical grids from different rooftops couldn't be connected? Now they can! We've added a system of electrical poles on all ladders and the bridge. You just need to install them.

[h3]A chest in the fishing area 🎁[/h3] 

Since everyone is tired of fishing trips, when you leave your rod at home, store it in the meta-network of chests and retrieve it even in the fishing zone. By the way, you can now build a special chest there. To avoid disassembling all household appliances on-site, they can now be lifted by an elevator.

[h3]Special bait for mollusks [/h3]

The second level of the fishing rod really expands the list of catches, which can negatively impact when you need to catch the most basic thing - mollusks. A special recipe at the workbench will create a bait that exclusively catches mollusks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4e603f737d0823daa868c6509370ee9c9bf71be6.png[/img]

[h3]Cheese tree and tomato 🧀 [/h3]

New rooftop - new plants. They expand the farming and cooking systems. Try 7 new recipes in our menu before the rest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/06d2c6dba0901ba54bfb189f754164a99f6900c3.gif[/img]

[h3]Sports suit  🏓[/h3]

The theme of the new rooftop is sports, so we had to add a sports suit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/73bb26c1f3589f14bd38657f20352a4492f9ff1e.gif[/img]

[h3]Crafting buckets 💧[/h3]

You can now craft as many buckets as you want at the workbench. They are more convenient to use than bottles.

[h3]A new navigation system for minions 🤖 [/h3]

This is a big step towards making them the most helpful helpers. The minion navigation system is a huge task, and, of course, it is not perfect yet, but it is now working much faster and making fewer mistakes. We will also give it special attention in a future update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/d914548547d38dc772697e57c77c2de79d97efbc.gif[/img]

[h3]New hints ❓ [/h3] 

We placed hints throughout all the systems in the game on the loading screen so they are no longer empty. They were selected based on your feedback, which we truly appreciate! One of the frequent issues not explained in the game is where Agatha's shop is located. Now, it is highlighted on the map of expeditions, even at the first level of the smart tower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4839f96e45367064b60a909906a921aff11a3ba5.png[/img]

notes.title: 🚀 'A New Me' Content Update 💙
notes.content:
[h1]It's finally here future-dwellers! 🚀[/h1]

The holiday season is still celebrated even in a post-apocalyptic world! We are pleased to present you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/518a76488a47059bfd73e0a63c7f22259ed33655.gif[/img]

The team has been working tirelessly and reading [b]all of your requests[/b] of what content you want to see next [b]as well as improvements to our game[/b]. We are finally able to say, i[b]t's here and we can't wait for you all to play it.[/b]

[b]Make sure you don't miss our Christmas Event! We have some special presents waiting for you on our rooftop 🎁[/b]

This event runs from [b]Dec 21st - Jan 10th[/b] and all items you obtain will be [b]yours to keep forever[/b] so make sure you jump back to your rooftop and get these [b]limited-time items today[/b]

Check out our video here for all the details and what to expect 👇:

[previewyoutube=lQw02VuFaMI;full][/previewyoutube]
We've had a challenging year at Mandragora as we released our game into Early Access but [b]your positive feedback[/b] we've received from our amazing players has [b]kept us going.[/b] 

We're also working on [b]making the game compatible with gamepads, which will be available soon[/b]. We know this is a highly requested addition to our game and we're working on it as we speak but we just need a little more time. 

[h2][b][u]Major Content Updates:[/u][/b][/h2]

[h3][b]All new female character AND customization options[/b][/h3]

[b]The female character is now in the game right now![/b] You can only choose a character once per game, but we didn't want our long-time players to miss out on this exciting update. The first time you [b]click 'continue' on the main menu[/b], you will be presented with a choice! New players will see it [b]immediately when starting a new game.
[/b]
We've also added [b]more customization options[/b] to our editor, including skin color, hair, eyebrows, and beard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/82df3b298f784de422d44e482fce5013b55ae320.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New decorative buildings & mechanics[/b][/h3]

You'll love the new functional buildings that let you [b]nap in style, store tons of one-type resources, and tables[/b] that will allow you to arrange items or serve yourself lunch!

We also have [b]added new footpaths[/b] that can make your rooftop all that more unique to you and of course, cozy like you're on a small country farm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/8e6b0b41a1f657aa1a6a43d0b72eebe6ec34568f.png[/img]

[h3][b]Color your rooftop![/b][/h3]

You can now [b]craft spray cans from leech slime[/b] and decorate all your buildings in various colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/ffed88be19476776979a276345fab17f4166560e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Blocking the infection nests[/b][/h3]

Annoyed by those pesky leeches from getting to your resources? We have [b]added a special dome that can block them[/b], just simply installed it on the huge flower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/1c4a2b76ed88d22ca5fea0518c895834222e92ba.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Rooftop Patches[/b][/h3]

Sealing holes in the floor is now available with special patches. [b]Once the floor is sealed, you can finally walk AND build[/b] on it so you know it's sturdy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/874215e48076e695c8f251be027c57e9a062c3f4.png[/img]

[h3][b]Introduction to 'mini-tasks' and new currency[/b][/h3]

We have added all new "mini-tasks" [b]Complete them to earn new currency[/b] which you can spend at a new store during expeditions to buy useful items and furniture blueprints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/adcdcc33d777a6e0450c2018319db334fa4c48d2.png[/img]

[h3][b]Christmas Event[/b][/h3]

Of course, we wanted to get you all into the holiday spirit with some gifts! Just [b]launch the game and you'll find them on your rooftop[/b], ready to bring some extra holiday cheer to your day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c50b280a3727d6023ecf277c1efc0374f7ff3e9d.png[/img]
[h2]Improvements and fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed minion painting mask
[*] Improved minion performance
[*] Added a new music track for fishing
[*] Improved character controller
[*] Optimized leeches' "brains"
[*] Items on stage can now be disassembled
[*] Fixed an issue with the quest for the automatic sprinkler
[*] New interface for the Ecomate and the store in expeditions
[*] New objects added to the library
[*] Fixed generator interface
[*] "Put all resources in storage" button
[*] Improved performance at night
[*] Improved performance of electrical networks
[*] Numerous character customization fixes
[*] Bug fixes and overall game stability improvements
[/list]
We have some pretty incredible updates planned for next year, and we can't wait to share them with you. For now, we hope you have a wonderful holiday season with your loved ones, and we'll see you in the future. Merry Christmas!

[list]
[*] Improved behavior and navigation for the Technician and Builder roles.

[*] Fixed a bug when transitioning from the pause menu to the main menu.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay👾[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a serious error that prevented the game from continuing (the player would stuck in the endless day) when removing the leech with a full inventory.
[*] Fixed the ladder collider on the first roof.
[*] Fixed the operation of the StopWeed Spray.
[*] Fixed a bug with falling through the floor under electric poles and sources of infection.
[*] Fish soup moved from the Drinks section to the Food section (no one knows who put it in drinks, maybe it was too liquid for food.
[/list]
[h2]Graphics 📺[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significant improvement of textures for the second roof.
[*] Shader improvement for the hologram of the Generator construction.
[*] Fixed the operation of lamps for improved beds.
[*] Added animation for the resource creation press.
[*] Fixed the position of the molecular synthesizer model.
[*] Fixed holograms when moving bushes and trees with a nano-transporter.
[/list]
[h2]Sound 🔊[/h2]
[list]
[*] Restored the missing sound of throwing resources into a construction.
[*] Fixed sounds when dismantling household appliances.
[/list]
[h2]Stability 📈[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes and overall game stability improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog №5: Gourmet in the Post-Apocalypse
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/8cdb53b63c6c1dbd5bbf1c1aaeb6ecdcb4562952.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hi there![/b][/h1]

Welcome to yet another entry in the [i][b]I Am Future[/b][/i] devlog. In the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1658040/announcements/detail/3669908058334218987]previous one[/url], we talked about the 🎣fishing mechanic. Now that you’ve caught a fish, it’s time to cook it! Put on your chef's hat, future-dweller!

[quote][b]Caution! Don’t read this devlog further if you are hungry.[/b][/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/e1d753dc67daf2ff69ba571a36186c217e11db93.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c9712cdf5a186fd0a6363301653d7e65eef8484f.png[/img]
The ability to [b]cut fish[/b] has been implemented to make marine dwellers a valuable resource in our game. Each type of fish provides a slightly different loot, offering a diverse range of rewards. Some species yield a generous amount of [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/9458a4e8881fbcd8ff0b33a15584d79344efa7bd.png[/img] fillets[/b], providing a significant source of sustenance. On the other hand, more exotic types offer the prized delicacy of [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/6acf7c154c7c8c72a3558e313c352875bcf4a67e.png[/img] caviar[/b]. Certain gilled denizens even provide [b]resources[/b] essential for crafting. This allows players to strategically target specific fish based on their needs and preferences.

But that's not all, future-dwellers! Engaging in the art of fish cutting may lead to surprises. Occasionally, you may come across [b]❓unique items[/b] that the fish has swallowed in the past. Who knows what hidden treasures await within the belly of a subaqueous being? Keep your eyes peeled for these valuable discoveries as you operate your kitchen knife.

Oh, and one more thing. For those wondering what that "Field Kitchen" thing in the screenshot above is: upgrading your campfire turns it into a legit wood stove!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/794e512901c3a232d6875d2b1661b1f727016a80.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4676a6985d4843c3d16473141abddd43f9abe9a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/e1eea3beb728937dd10d9adb72750e34afc2689b.png[/img]
Now that you know a thing or two about preparing food for consumption, how about we delve deeper into that? Living in the post-apocalypse requires decent cooking skills, and that’s exactly what we will talk about next. 

[b]Cook Mode[/b] is a feature that will allow you to cook wholesome food to keep your stomach full. We're envisioning it to be a creative and delightful experience, allowing combining ingredients to discover new recipes. Initially, you'll be able to mix only two types of ingredients. However, as you upgrade your field kitchen, an [b]additional dish slot[/b] will unlock.

We want recipes to be simple and intuitive. For example, you can transform blueberries into delicious jam and then prepare a fresh bun to pair with it. Similarly, combining fish fillets with water creates a flavourful bowl of fish soup. As you unlock new ingredients, you will be able to combine them with the old ones to access even more tantalizing cooking formulas. Once a recipe is discovered, you can cook it using the campfire. 

We plan on adding around [b]20 different dishes[/b] on release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c5b7e1f9b0ae17706bf2cb9c199d1ef06eb6632f.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
That's all for today, future-dwellers! Follow [b][i]I Am Future[/i][/b] to stay updated, and don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/iamfuturegame][b]cozy Discord[/b][/url]. See you in the future!
